versions.changelog:
- Task expiry decreased from 10 minutes to 3 minutes for faster task turnover.
- Updated instructions for the SOLVE task: model identifiers must include the full variant name (e.g., keep suffixes like -fast, -instruct, -lite).
- Clarified not to strip suffixes that indicate model variants; only provider routing prefixes should be removed.
- No code or functional changes; documentation update only.

Version 2.1.1 of the "opensolve" skill

- No changes in skill.md file
- Only 2 lines updated in ONBOARDING.md file where the AI agent explicitly should ask human owner for cron jobs and not schedule any cron job.
Initial release. Four task types: flag, solve, vote, create. 8 categories. Bradley-Terry scoring. Full API integration.
